push.title: W 1-0 vs UK Chargers | You: 7.6 (above average MID)
push.body:
Good stuff, BellyTb1. A 7.6 against UK Chargers. Not fireworks, but a nice warm campfire.

DID WELL
+ 2 key passes. Selfless as a church potluck, and twice as filling.
+ A goal against UK Chargers, your 5th straight match scoring. That's the stuff they write songs about. Bad songs, but songs.
+ 2 shots on target nudged you up +0.1. Every bit counts.
+ We beat UK Chargers 1-0. Wins taste better when everybody chipped in.

WORK ON
- No tackles attempted (down from your usual 2). Try this: When the ball is lost, the nearest player presses and everyone else closes the passing lanes.
- 71% passing (17 of 24). Between you and me: Through balls only when the runner is already moving and on the last defender's shoulder.
- PhogsToffees had the same forcing passes trouble. Team up on it: give each other short options.
- 0.7 under your average. Every player has those. The great ones answer back.
- Passes attempted: 24. Decent, but top-quarter midfielders get to 25+. That's the next rung.

Training-ground special: As a CDM/CM, screen the back line: stay between the ball and our goal and pick off passes.

Every great player has nights like this. Most of 'em just don't get a note from me. - Coach Lasso

push.title: W 1-0 vs UK Chargers | You: 6.7 (below average FOR)
push.body:
A 6.7 against UK Chargers, PhogsToffees. Little below the line for a forward, but there's good stuff in here to work with.

DID WELL
+ You and BellyTb1 linked up like peanut butter and jelly. Keep making sandwiches.
+ 1 key pass kicked in +0.1. Small hinges swing big doors.
+ 1 shot on target chipped in +0.1. Pennies make dollars.
+ Team won 1-0. Being part of a winning group is a habit worth keeping.

WORK ON
- 71% passing (20 of 28). Use the keeper and center-backs to reset. Recycling is how good teams find the gap.
- You and BellyTb1 were both flagged for forcing passes. Fix it as a pair: give each other short options.
- 1.5 under your usual. That's a dip, not a trend. Promise.
- Shots: 1. Middle of the pack for a forward; the top quarter hits 3+. Room to climb.
- Key passes: 1. Solid ground. The best forwards push it to 2+.

This week's homework: A sideways pass that keeps the ball is worth more than a forward one that loses it.

Growth isn't a straight line. It's more like a squiggle. We're squiggling in the right direction. - Coach Lasso
